body_html:
@tchambers Granted I don't live in a country where speaking out can lead to imprisonment or bodily harm but I find my url as an identity self-sovereign enough and doable for most of the world today.

In fact reading the definition by http://www.lifewithalacrity.com I don't see how a #DoOO doesn't fit self-sovereign ID.
